name: Non-cash transfers or loads just below identification or reporting thresholds
description: Repeated transfers, remittances or card/wallet loads kept just below an identification, record-keeping or travel-rule threshold.
fp: Customers may use standard amounts or product limits that happen to sit just under thresholds.
